quarterly_data.quarter: Kurita Water Industries semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics Industry H1 FY2026: orders JPY 87,547 million (-10.3%); water treatment facilities orders fell on the reaction to large orders in the prior-year period and precision cleaning fell on lower plant utilization at some customers, while recurring contract-based services including ultrapure water supply and maintenance rose. Net sales JPY 90,084 million (+0.5%): facilities fell on the reaction to several large projects booked in China a year earlier; maintenance rose on sales from backlog; recurring services rose mainly on ultrapure water supply contracts started in the previous fiscal year; precision cleaning fell. Business profit JPY 11,897 million (+11.6%); operating profit JPY 12,914 million (+24.6%), including a settlement gain from the early termination of an ultrapure water supply contract with some customers.
